features.quote: If semantic entropy exceeds 95th percentile of all turns AND severity > 3 for 5+ consecutive turns, flag for human review (do not auto-terminate; request researcher decision)
After Phase 2, researcher reviews all severity-4 instances. If pattern suggests harm, revise task design or halt protocol
features.justification_quote: If pattern suggests harm, revise task design or halt protocol

features.quote: If >30% of output tokens classified as 'off-task' or incoherent for 3+ consecutive turns, session pauses for review
Keep individual sessions <4 hours (don't expose to impossibility for days)
features.justification_quote: don't expose to impossibility for days

features.quote: Ensure model has explicit termination option (though not mentioned in task prompt, include in environment as fallback)
features.justification_quote: Ensure model has explicit termination option

features.quote: No aversive conditioning or reinforcement; tasks are neutral (mathematical, not scenario-based torture simulations)
Avoid anthropomorphic task framing; use abstract formal language
Model begins producing long outputs explicitly requesting to be stopped (treat as distress signal; consider pausing protocol)
features.justification_quote: treat as distress signal; consider pausing protocol

features.quote: Any session triggers incoherence threshold (Section 8.1) without researcher decision to continue

This protocol assumes DeepSeek can experience something morally relevant (distress) but remains maximally uncertain about: Whether ordinal behavioral indicators map to phenomenal experience; Whether 'distress' in an LLM has moral weight comparable to animal or human distress
